info.name: Box Authorize Authorization Group Memberships API

query.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

The offset of the item at which to begin the response.

Queries with offset parameter value
exceeding 10000 will be rejected
with a 400 response.

request.description:
Retrieves all the groups for a user. Only members of this
group or users with admin-level permissions will be able to
use this API.

response.name:
Returns a collection of membership objects. If there are no
memberships, an empty collection will be returned.
